When done, you could remove the Spectrum account, No change in thunderbird. When you are ready to leave spectrum, do this:

  1. install the addon, importexporttools NG
  2. click file>offline>download to be sure that all spectrum messages are on pc
  3. highlight each folder in spectrum account to save, one at a time, and rightclick, select the importexport option to export mbox
  4. next, highlight Local Folders, rightclick, and, one at a time, rightclick and select importexport option to import mbox
  5. after doing that, spot check to ensure all messages are in Local Folders. Once done, you can remove the spectrum account.
  6. now, all spectrum messages are in Local Folders, If you want them on the Outlook account, highlight each folder, select all, and then right click and select COPY to desired outlook folder. Check that all content is on the outlook account, as uploading to IMAP can be problematic
  7. once all the message folders have been copied to outlook and you've verified them, you can delete the local folder

content:
Why would you do that? If everything is working, why redo it? Yes, it is a simple procedure.


BACKUP

  1. ensure thunderbird is not running
  2. enter %appdata% in search window on task bar and press Enter key
  3. this should open windows file explorer in Appdata\roaming folder
  4. highlight the Thunderbird folder and copy to external media

RESTORE

  1. ensure thunderbird is installed, run once, and NOT running
  2. enter %appdata% in search window on task bar and press Enter key
  3. delete the thunderbird folder
  4. you should be in Appdata\roaming folder , copy&paste the exported Thunderbird folder there.
  5. start thunderbird and all should be there

Ich bin nicht sicher, ob die von dir gefundenen Dateien die richtigen sind, und das aufgrund ihrer geringen Größe. Bei mir - unter macOS - haben die Dateien abook.sqlite und history.sqlite von leeren Adressbüchern schon eine Größe von jeweils 262 kB. Und Adressbücher mit mehreren Hundert Kontakten werden dann schon mal bis zu 1 MB groß.

Dennoch hier schon mal eine Anleitung zum Ersetzen der aktuellen abook.sqlite und history.sqlite in deiner neuen Thunderbird Installation durch die aus dem alten Profil: in Thunderbird gehe nach Hilfe > Informationen zur Fehlerbehebung > Profilordner > Ordner öffnen, dann Thunderbird beenden. Jetzt ist der Profilordner im Explorer geöffnet und du kannst die aktuellen abook.sqlite und history.sqlite Dateien ersetzen durch die, die du in Thunderbird.old gefunden hast. Beim nächsten Start sollten deine Adressen bzw. Kontakte wieder angezeigt werden.

Additional findings from November 9–10, 2026

Hello,

I would like to provide an update on my Thunderbird freezing issue.

I performed further tests on November 9–10, 2026, and obtained the following results.

1. Freezing after restarting Windows

- I restarted Windows 10. - I started Thunderbird 153.6.0esr in Troubleshoot Mode. - I manually checked for new POP3 messages from @nifty. - All messages were successfully received, although the process took longer than usual. - Approximately 30 minutes later, Thunderbird froze without further user interaction. - Thunderbird's CPU usage was approximately 40%. - I had to terminate Thunderbird using Windows Task Manager.

2. Freezing triggered by manual mail retrieval

I performed another test under different conditions.

- I started Thunderbird in Troubleshoot Mode. - I left Thunderbird running for 60 minutes without manually checking for new messages. - Thunderbird remained responsive throughout those 60 minutes. - I then manually checked for new POP3 messages. - Thunderbird froze during the retrieval process. - CPU usage again remained at approximately 40%. - I had to terminate Thunderbird using Task Manager.

Both automatic checks for new messages at startup and periodic automatic checks are disabled.

3. Windows Event Viewer findings

Windows Event Viewer recorded the following information for a freeze on November 9:

- Application Hang — Event ID 1002 - Windows Error Reporting — Event ID 1001 - Event name: AppHangB1 - Application: thunderbird.exe - Version: 153.6.0.0 - Hang type: Top level window is idle - Failure bucket ID: 1522252194653677288

The Windows Error Reporting record also lists diagnostic files named `minidump.mdmp` and `memory.hdmp`. I have not verified whether these files are still available.

4. Mail provider verification

I confirmed that @nifty webmail can receive and send messages normally.

5. Request for advice

These results suggest that the freezing may be associated with POP3 mail retrieval or processing triggered by retrieval, although the cause remains unknown.

Could you advise me on how to identify the cause, particularly whether there are Thunderbird diagnostic logs or other safe debugging methods that would help?

My goal is to keep Thunderbird running continuously and automatically check for new mail every 10 minutes.

I would like to avoid repeating tests already performed and preserve my existing email data.
